## Why this article

The project owner chose the topic 决策树. The article with that exact title carries a 疑似拷贝粘贴 (suspected copy-paste) maintenance template, so its text may not really be under CC BY-SA, and it is mainly about decision analysis. This article covers decision trees in machine learning and carried no maintenance templates on 2026-11-05.

## Changes made

The article was captured with headless Google Chrome at 1024 CSS pixels wide, using a fresh browser profile with no sign-in or cookies. The full-page screenshot was cut into 6 pages of 1024 × 768 pixels, each starting 640 pixels below the previous one, so consecutive pages overlap. The last page ends at the article's cut-off and overlaps more. Pages were then scaled to 800 × 600 and saved as JPG, the same size as the `wiki-ml-zh` images. The capture covers the article from the top of the page to the start of the 参见 (See also) section. The see-also list, references, external links and footer were not captured. The text was not edited.
